name: adlc
description: Agentic Development Life Cycle harness. A persistent Markdown wiki as the knowledge substrate (Karpathy LLM-wiki pattern, OKF-aligned; Obsidian-flavoured, read in Obsidian or wiki-renderer), optional code navigation (a graphify code graph, or the Semble and Serena MCP servers), an optional design worker (impeccable, taste-skill, a design-system folder), role skills for BA / product / architecture work, and a plan-driven delivery loop that dispatches build / test / review / verify workers story by story. The vault's Toolset block picks the tools; AGENTS.md project profiling calibrates the harness to each repo. Formerly claude-mem.
